annotations.text:
The polished pass: Archivo brand type, one compact search band replacing the tall collage hero, the spotlight as one big 3:2 card with a quiet list beside it (nobody swipes to be seen), and calmer cards with one accent per surface.

Every rail is still a query — Fresh, Most visited this week, Just opened — and a rail that cannot fill hides itself. Shop names and product counts are sample; no totals, no rates.
Kept as the record of why the hero is one shop and not a queue of eight. Decided 2026-08-25.
